reviews.text: The only place I take Mac for his grooming.  Staff are lovely and the prices are reasonable

Our dog is showing signs of entering her first season. I told them to be careful with her. I would have happily stayed with her; she's a very small dog. They were no help and talked to me as if my dog had the plague. I waited over two months for this appointment. I will never be back; they have a terrible attitude and are so unhelpful.
